parts.name: Adventitia
parts.description: Loose outer connective tissue of a lower thoracic specimen. No serosa is shown; short abdominal oesophagus is outside scope.

parts.name: Basal epithelial nuclear profiles
parts.description: Contained intracellular nuclear profiles within individually fitted cells. Modest deterministic size/shape variation preserves basal-to-surface flattening and retained superficial nuclei. Sampling is schematic.

parts.name: Basal squamous epithelial layer
parts.description: Thin basal cell domain follows stromal papillae. Its nuclei provide cell-scale context in the anterior tissue section.

parts.name: Basement membrane
parts.description: Thin continuous shape-fitting epithelial-stromal interface. Thickness exaggerated; not a separate cell layer.

parts.name: Circular fascicle relief
parts.description: Shallow relief indicates the local orthogonal fascicle direction. Muscle-cell ultrastructure and upper oesophageal skeletal striations are outside scope.

parts.name: Compound submucosal gland 1
parts.description: Six sampled blind-ending tubuloacinar secretory branches join a central collecting route. Hollow connected architecture is schematic, not a cell census. Mucous gland proper lies below muscularis mucosae.

parts.name: Compound submucosal gland 2
parts.description: Six sampled blind-ending tubuloacinar secretory branches join a central collecting route. Hollow connected architecture is schematic, not a cell census. Mucous gland proper lies below muscularis mucosae.

parts.name: Compound submucosal gland 3
parts.description: Six sampled blind-ending tubuloacinar secretory branches join a central collecting route. Hollow connected architecture is schematic, not a cell census. Mucous gland proper lies below muscularis mucosae.

parts.name: Flattened superficial nuclear profiles
parts.description: Contained intracellular nuclear profiles within individually fitted cells. Modest deterministic size/shape variation preserves basal-to-surface flattening and retained superficial nuclei. Sampling is schematic.

parts.name: Inner circular smooth muscle
parts.description: Inner circular smooth muscle, oriented transversely in this opened local wall crop. No discrete lower sphincter ring is implied.

parts.name: Inner circular smooth muscle dissection cover
parts.description: Removable front teaching window, fitted to its retained host. Hiding it reveals normally embedded tissue; this is a dissection opening, not a natural cavity.

parts.name: Intermediate epithelial nuclear profiles
parts.description: Contained intracellular nuclear profiles within individually fitted cells. Modest deterministic size/shape variation preserves basal-to-surface flattening and retained superficial nuclei. Sampling is schematic.

parts.name: Intermediate squamous epithelial layers
parts.description: Multiple intermediate cell strata between basal and flattened superficial domains. Tissue is nonkeratinized stratified squamous; cellular sampling is schematic.

parts.name: Lamina propria and papillae
parts.description: Connective tissue extends as low papillae into basal epithelium. Shape-fitting epithelial basal interfaces enclose these papillae; no villi or surface keratin.

parts.name: Lamina propria and papillae dissection cover
parts.description: Removable front teaching window, fitted to its retained host. Hiding it reveals normally embedded tissue; this is a dissection opening, not a natural cavity.

parts.name: Local lymphatic vessel
parts.description: Hollow local through-specimen vessel with a sampled transverse course with patent boundary ends. Caliber enlarged. Extra-wall portal/systemic or collecting routes are outside this tissue crop.

parts.name: Longitudinal fascicle relief
parts.description: Shallow relief indicates the local orthogonal fascicle direction. Muscle-cell ultrastructure and upper oesophageal skeletal striations are outside scope.

parts.name: Muscularis mucosae
parts.description: Continuous longitudinal smooth-muscle sheet follows the fold. Gland ducts traverse fitted perforations in this sheet.

parts.name: Myenteric connective tissue plane
parts.description: Intermuscular connective tissue plane between longitudinal and circular muscle. The myenteric network lies within it.

parts.name: Myenteric connective tissue plane dissection cover
parts.description: Removable front teaching window, fitted to its retained host. Hiding it reveals normally embedded tissue; this is a dissection opening, not a natural cavity.

parts.name: Myenteric plexus
parts.description: Sampled connected ganglia and neural strands within the intermuscular connective tissue plane. Caliber enlarged; no molecular machinery or motion.

parts.name: Outer longitudinal smooth muscle
parts.description: Longitudinal smooth muscle of this lower thoracic sample. Upper skeletal and middle mixed regions are intentionally not combined into this local crop.

parts.name: Papillary capillary loops and basal channels
parts.description: Twelve sampled patent hairpin loops connect paired basal microvascular channels inside lamina propria. Tips remain below the shape-fitting basement membrane. Uniform red color does not encode oxygenation; capillary caliber and sampling are enlarged. No vessels occupy avascular epithelium.

parts.name: Patent gland duct 1
parts.description: Continuous epithelial-walled duct from the gland collecting route through muscularis mucosae and mucosa to a true surface opening. Cuboidal to stratified-cuboidal duct lining is represented as a simplified wall; duct caliber exaggerated for inspection.

parts.name: Patent gland duct 2
parts.description: Continuous epithelial-walled duct from the gland collecting route through muscularis mucosae and mucosa to a true surface opening. Cuboidal to stratified-cuboidal duct lining is represented as a simplified wall; duct caliber exaggerated for inspection.

parts.name: Patent gland duct 3
parts.description: Continuous epithelial-walled duct from the gland collecting route through muscularis mucosae and mucosa to a true surface opening. Cuboidal to stratified-cuboidal duct lining is represented as a simplified wall; duct caliber exaggerated for inspection.

parts.name: Sparse submucosal plexus
parts.description: Sampled connected ganglia and neural strands within submucosa. Sparse oesophageal sampling, deliberately reduced relative to intestinal plexuses. Caliber enlarged; no molecular machinery or motion.

parts.name: Submucosa
parts.description: Connective tissue core of longitudinal mucosal folds, containing glands, vessels and sparse submucosal nerves. Sampled glands and fibers are enlarged for recognition.

parts.name: Submucosa dissection cover
parts.description: Removable front teaching window, fitted to its retained host. Hiding it reveals normally embedded tissue; this is a dissection opening, not a natural cavity.

parts.name: Submucosal artery
parts.description: Hollow local through-specimen vessel with a sampled transverse course with patent boundary ends. Caliber enlarged. Extra-wall portal/systemic or collecting routes are outside this tissue crop.

parts.name: Submucosal vein
parts.description: Hollow local through-specimen vessel with a sampled transverse course with patent boundary ends. Caliber enlarged. Extra-wall portal/systemic or collecting routes are outside this tissue crop.

parts.name: Superficial nucleated squamous layers
parts.description: Two fitted strata of irregular broad flattened nonkeratinized cells line the lumen. Deterministic staggered polygonal packing and thin rounded seams are teaching samples; retained flattened nuclei are resolved on the section. No cornified layer or cell-density claim.
